scope: TEST ONLY direct-network IPv4, DNS, and IPv6 positive-control probes; no VPN tunnel or server changes
interpretation: The owner phone provides a positive direct IPv6 control over Wi-Fi using the test probe UID. The tablet has no SIM and was tested only over Wi-Fi; the fixed IPv6 probe host failed system DNS resolution there, while the separate fixed UDP DNS control succeeded.
limitations: This is not a packet capture or DNS/IPv6 leak audit.
No included/excluded VPN traffic was captured before NAT or during transitions/failures.
The earlier direct-network baseline receipt is preserved as a separate run.
privacy: No device serials, account identifiers, IP addresses, DNS names, MAC addresses, or packet contents are stored.
